integrity: The proof uses elementary barycentric geometry, a local cone change of variables and analytic Lagrange inversion; exact arithmetic and finite quadrature supplement, but do not replace, the proof. Historical priority has residual unindexed-literature uncertainty; external independent validation was not conducted.
scientific_limitations: Local near-diameter expansion only; regular Euclidean simplices in fixed integer dimension at least four; not a global distance law or a uniform-in-dimension remainder. The explicit convergence radius is not optimized. Lower-dimensional exact correlation formulas and general chord relationships predate this claim.
title: The rational diameter-endpoint germ of random-pair distances in regular simplices
